maps.name: China
maps.description: The whole country at one scale, Taiwan and the South China Sea islands with it: the plateau a tall rim, the plains at its foot, the great rivers bridged where roads cross. Eight seats, a city each. Experimental: the biggest map there is.

zh.name: 中国
zh.description: 整个国家在同一比例尺上，含台湾与南海诸岛，依图绘制：高原是高崖围起的第一阶梯，其下是第二阶梯，平原在山脚，大江大河在干线公路过处架桥。八个席位，各据一城。实验性质：引擎所能承载的最大地图。

ko.name: 중국
ko.description: 나라 전체를 한 축척으로, 타이완과 남중국해의 섬들까지 해도대로 그렸다: 고원은 높은 절벽으로 둘러싸인 첫 계단, 그 아래 둘째 계단, 산기슭의 평원, 간선도로가 지나는 곳마다 다리가 놓인 큰 강들. 여덟 자리, 도시 하나씩. 실험적: 엔진이 감당하는 가장 큰 지도.

maps.author: Rene Wang

maps.name: Eightfold Wood
maps.description: A large green map for a full table of eight. Thick forest through the middle that armour has to go round, water at the edges, and a seat in every corner and along every side.
maps.author: Rene Wang

maps.name: Europe
maps.description: The continent at one scale, Iceland to the Black Sea and Lapland to Crete: the Alps and the Scandes as massifs, the great rivers bridged where roads cross, the Maginot Line for Paris. Eight seats, a capital each. Experimental.

zh.name: 欧洲
zh.description: 整个欧洲大陆在同一比例尺上，自冰岛至黑海、自拉普兰至克里特：阿尔卑斯与斯堪的纳维亚山脉为山体，大河在干线公路过处架桥，马奇诺防线属于巴黎。八个席位，各据一都。实验性质。

ko.name: 유럽
ko.description: 대륙 전체를 한 축척으로, 아이슬란드에서 흑해까지, 라플란드에서 크레타까지: 알프스와 스칸디나비아 산맥은 산괴로, 큰 강들은 간선도로가 지나는 곳마다 다리로, 마지노선은 파리의 것. 여덟 자리, 수도 하나씩. 실험적.

maps.author: Rene Wang

maps.name: Frostbite Basin
maps.description: A medium snowfield for four. Woods along the middle ground for infantry to hide in, a frozen lake to fight over, and the ore out in the open where an army has to stand to take it.
maps.author: Rene Wang

maps.name: 八方河谷
maps.description: 尺寸：168×140；阵营数：8。八方分布的河谷平原对战地图，中心通道与山地边缘均为关键争夺区。
maps.author: yueheifg

maps.name: 中东-末忆铁锈
maps.description: 中东战略图。底图来自铁锈盒子。奥斯曼方：2-红-利雅得、3-绿-萨那、5-青-安卡拉、6-粉-大马士革。英国/阿拉伯方：1-蓝-马斯喀特、4-黄-开罗、7-橙-巴格达、8-白-德黑兰。
maps.author: YYY

maps.name: Tidewater
maps.description: A small wet map for four: a flooded middle with sand spits and shallows between the seats, palms on the beaches. Quick by boat, slow on foot; whoever holds the crossings holds the ore.
maps.author: Rene Wang

maps.name: 海岸两线（2v2）
maps.description: 虽然叫海岸，但一点也不海岸。本图灵感源自铁锈《隔岸之争》与《海岸线》两张图。

en.name: Two Coast Lanes (2v2)
en.description: Called "Coast", but there is nothing coastal about it. Inspired by two Rusted Warfare maps: Across the Shore (隔岸之争) and Coastline (海岸线).

maps.author: 进水
